name: @sos-2/infra-production-connectivity
description: SOS 2.0 Production-Connectivity Wiring Harness (Work Order P17-A, persistence/deployment lane): the wiring harness/scripts per the infra/deployment precedent — the composition layer that assembles the REAL free-tier persistence + deployment stack from the environment at the process boundary (P3 registry variable names; credentials env-only, injected once at this boundary and never echoed), runs the REAL startup probes (honest states — UNKNOWN before a probe, CONNECTED/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED after; never fabricated), and emits the machine-readable evidence records (connectivity transcripts, provider states, deployment revision records) consumed by docs/evidence/production-connectivity/persistence-deployment. Includes the secrets-audit harness (scan owned paths for secret-shaped values; findings carry pattern ids only) and the zero-external-dependency + import-boundary checks (the P3 check-zero-deps discipline, continued). Deterministic reference-mode: the wiring logic runs offline against scripted seams (injected clocks; no ambient env in src); network happens only in the env-gated integration suite (RUN_REAL=1, tests/real-persistence).

scripts.verify:contracts: node scripts/check-zero-deps.mjs && node scripts/secret-scan.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
